description: Ministry of Higher Education - Amendments to the Gaz. Ex. Ordinary No. 916/7 of March 27, 1966 - Order of the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka under sec. 27(1) of the Universities Act No. 16 of 1978
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under Section 27(1) of the Act to amend the establishment order of the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka by adding a new Department of Political Science. While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about modifying the legal framework governing university structures.
